pair.title: Pair a computer
pair.description:
In Sidekick's tray, open **Connection settings**, enter your Home Assistant HTTPS address and this pairing code:

**{code}**

The code expires in five minutes. Once Sidekick shows a confirmation number, select **Submit** to review the computer.

confirm.title: Approve {name}

data.verified: I verified the confirmation number on this computer

error.waiting_for_device: Waiting for Sidekick. Enter the code in its Connection settings, then try again.
error.pairing_expired: The previous pairing expired or disconnected. Use the new code below.
error.confirmation_required: Verify the matching confirmation number before approving.

abort.already_configured: This computer is already paired. Use Reconfigure to replace its pairing.
abort.too_many_pairings: Too many active pairing attempts. Wait five minutes and try again.

init.title: Sidekick connection
init.description: Revoking immediately disconnects this computer. Use Reconfigure to pair it again. Metric, shutdown, and audio permissions are controlled in the Sidekick tray.
